sources.title: Shaoguan city records September 21 Shaotang project commencement event
sources.summary: Government report records a September 21 commencement event for China Telecom Shaotang. Event supports announced status; no physical work stage is inferred.
sources.date_semantics: Publication September 22 explicitly dates the commencement event September 21. Ceremony treated as project announcement, not physical construction observation.

sources.title: China Telecom Shaotang campus 220kV substation environmental impact report, public version
sources.publisher: Shaoguan Ecology and Environment Bureau / Guangdong Shaoke Environmental Technology
sources.attribution: Shaoguan Ecology and Environment Bureau / Guangdong Shaoke Environmental Technology
sources.summary: Scanned PDF pages 3 and 17 give substation center geographic coordinates; page 18 places it in northwest corner of the data-center campus. Only on-campus support-infrastructure location is used.
sources.date_semantics: Undated PDF. Linked by official September 17 acceptance notice; publication date not inferred from the PDF itself.
sources.coordinate_crs: Geographic longitude/latitude; datum not stated in inspected source. No datum transform asserted.

sources.title: China Mobile Beijing International Information Port No6 supervision tender candidates
sources.summary: No6/C18 location northeast of the existing International Information Port; procurement stage only. Prospective service dates do not establish site works.

sources.title: China Mobile Beijing No6 project registration
sources.summary: Two data-center buildings, two power buildings and basement, at International Information Port northeast C18 parcel. Listed project approvals are internal China Mobile approvals, not government construction permissions.

sources.title: GDS announces two Langfang data-center projects entered implementation
sources.summary: Two unnamed projects launched at September 11-13 conference. Anci/Xianghe cluster totals and 21 operating centers cannot identify the two projects or their sites.
sources.date_semantics: Conference event interval September 11-13; September 14 is publication. No exact individual project construction date established.

sources.title: Xinhua first-hand reporting from Inner Mongolia computing campuses
sources.summary: Reporter describes two VNET northern-campus buildings topped out with mechanical equipment arriving; September 10 photos identify Ulanqab No1 base. Text does not exactly date the separate northern-campus observation or bind it to VNET N-OR investor codes.
sources.date_semantics: Published October 12. Photos have September 10 captions, but those captions do not prove the separate described northern-campus two-building work observation happened on the same date.
